name: EliteCart
summary: Shopify cart drawer with one-click add-ons, a reward bar, in-cart upsells and translations, plus targeted upsell flows and checkout add-ons on higher plans.
best_for: Shopify stores that want a designed cart drawer with one-click add-ons, a reward bar and in-cart upsells, from a single-language store on Essentials to a multilingual store with targeted upsell flows on Professional
skip_if: you want to try a cart drawer without paying after the trial, since there is no free plan; or you need a price you can predict at high order volumes, because the volume ladder is not published
honest_knock: There is no free plan, and beyond the included 200 or 500 orders the price scales with volume on a ladder EliteCart does not publish, only two examples. The trial is 15 days on the listing and 14 on the pricing page. Checkout add-ons need Shopify Plus and the $79.99 plan, and we found no cancellation or refund policy.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Essentials · per month, billed every 30 days through Shopify in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-15 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/elite-cart-upsell and elitecart.app/pricing, prices in USD) Two published plans and one on request, with no free plan. Essentials, called Essential on EliteCart's own pricing page, is $29.99 a month and includes 200 orders a month with one language and conversion analytics; above that the price scales with order volume, and the listing gives one example, an additional $10 for 500 orders. Professional is $79.99 a month, includes 500 orders a month and adds unlimited languages with AI translations, unlimited targeted upsell flows and custom HTML, CSS and AI sections; its example is an additional $20 for 750 orders. Enterprise is 'Contact us': everything in Professional plus an account manager, onboarding, no order limits, a custom SLA and annual plans. All charges are billed in USD, recurring and usage-based charges every 30 days through Shopify. The listing offers a 15-day free trial, while the pricing page says 14 days. The full volume ladder is not published, only the two examples.

schema_offer.description: Essentials, billed every 30 days through Shopify in USD; includes 200 orders a month, then scales with order volume (listing example: an additional $10 for 500 orders); Professional $79.99 a month includes 500 orders (example: an additional $20 for 750 orders); Enterprise on request with no order limits and annual plans; no free plan; 15-day trial on the listing, 14 days on elitecart.app/pricing. Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-10-15.

price_history.method: Stable = every amount on the vendor's pricing page identical across >= 3 of our reads over >= 30 days. A change is listed only after we confirmed the new price on the page, with a verbatim quote. Differences in raw readings are never published on their own.

compare_with.name: Assortion
compare_with.why: Assortion is in our dossiers too and also combines cart customization with upsells, cross-sells and add-ons, but it starts lower and publishes its whole ladder: $9.99 a month up to 50 orders, $19.99 up to 200 and $34.99 up to 500 when we read it on 15 October 2026. EliteCart starts at $29.99 a month for 200 orders, with a reward bar in the cart and AI translations and custom sections on Professional, but beyond the included orders only gives examples. For a small store on a budget, look at Assortion; for a multilingual store that wants more control over the cart drawer, EliteCart.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested EliteCart on a Shopify development store: the install, the app embed switched on and saved in the theme, a cart drawer in the theme preview (not proven to be EliteCart alone, because the cart apps Cross Sell Auto and Essential Cart were also switched on, and the Buy Two discount came from another app), the plan screen with the order slider, the Shopify approval screen for Essentials (not approved, a payment method was asked) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid. Install: the install form was sent at 14:13 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog for EliteCart & Upsell by GEFA Technology with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved. The app opened on Welcome to EliteCart with a Get started list (1 of 4 complete). Step 3, Start your trial, said that as a Shopify Partner development store we have free access and need not subscribe. No separate account, demo or call was asked. Core action, turn on the cart drawer and look at it in the theme preview, about 2 minutes (14:14 to 14:15) and 13 steps: in the theme editor, in our own tab, the app embed EliteCart & Upsell was switched on and the theme was SAVED (Changes saved.), because that was needed to see a result. In the preview we went to The Complete Snowboard and pressed Add to cart. A cart drawer opened with The Complete Snowboard, Color: Ice, a label Buy Two, a price of $629.96 with $699.95 struck through, a row Matching Items with The Collection Snowboard: Liquid $749.95, The Multi-managed Snowboard $629.95 and The Multi-location Snowboard $729.95, and at the bottom Subtotal $1,399.90 USD, Discount -$139.98 USD, Total $1,259.92 USD and a CHECKOUT button. After Activate the Get started list showed 2 of 4 complete. IMPORTANT, this result is not proven to be EliteCart alone: our development store also had the cart apps Cross Sell Auto and Essential Cart switched on in the theme. With EliteCart off, the cart icon showed a different drawer (Cart - 1, You may also like); with EliteCart on, the cart icon still opened that other drawer, and the Matching Items drawer appeared only when Add to cart was pressed. We believe the Matching Items drawer comes from EliteCart because it appeared after the embed was switched on, but this was not confirmed separately in the Cart designer. The Buy Two discount (Discount -$139.98 USD) came from another app and cannot be credited to EliteCart. So we do not claim the drawer as a proven EliteCart result; what is proven here is the install, the plans, the approval screen and the uninstall. Plans: the Plans screen says Free access for development stores. You can access all features for free. Once you switch to a paid Shopify plan or transfer the store, you must select a plan below. A slider How many orders do you have per month? starts at 200: Essentials $29.99 /month, Includes 200 orders / month, Try for free; Professional $79.99 /month, Includes 500 orders / month, Most popular, Try for free; Enterprise Contact us, For an individual quote. With the slider at 5000 orders Essentials showed $199.99 /month and Professional $399.99 /month, both with 5000 orders a month. The ladder between 200 and 5000 orders was not opened step by step, and the dossier example of an extra $10 at 500 orders was not checked. Checkout: Try for free on Essentials opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: You have a 15-day free trial ending on 2 Dec., Subtotal $29,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $29,99 Due 2 Dec, $29,99 USD every 30 days, an app spending limit of a maximum of $229,99 USD per 30 days, and a note that usage charges come on top. The button Add payment method was shown and Approve was greyed out. The sentence You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on this screen and a payment method was asked, so we did not approve, no card was entered, and we pressed Cancel. Nothing was approved. The listing says a 15-day trial and the dossier pricing page says 14 days; the Shopify screen said 15. Cancelling: no paid plan was ever started, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the row of the app and the menu (Open app, View details, Get support, Uninstall). The dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required before Uninstall becomes active; we first pressed Cancel and later uninstalled the app with the reason Testing multiple apps, and Shopify confirmed that the app was uninstalled. Not tested: the Cart designer, one-click add-ons, the reward bar, the Upsells flows, Language and translations (multilingual), AI translations, EliteAI Ultra, Analytics, the paid plans and a real charge, the Plus checkout add-ons and the vendor help. Clean up: the theme was saved with the EliteCart app embed switched on (needed for the result; a second save changed nothing); the other cart apps in the store were left as they were. Our own tabs were closed. The app was uninstalled after the files were written. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Other cart apps in the store were switched on, so the drawer in the preview could not be credited to EliteCart alone, the app embed had to be switched on and saved in the theme editor, the Essentials approval screen needs a payment method and has no test charge sentence, and usage charges come on top of the subscription.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested EliteCart on a Shopify development store: the install, the app embed switched on and saved in the theme, a cart drawer in the theme preview (not proven to be EliteCart alone, because the cart apps Cross Sell Auto and Essential Cart were also switched on, and the Buy Two discount came from another app), the plan screen with the order slider, the Shopify approval screen for Essentials (not approved, a payment method was asked) and the uninstall dialog, after which the app was uninstalled. Nothing was paid. Install: the install form was sent at 14:13 in our own tab; Shopify showed the Install app dialog for EliteCart & Upsell by GEFA Technology with View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data, and the install was approved. The app opened on Welcome to EliteCart with a Get started list (1 of 4 complete). Step 3, Start your trial, said that as a Shopify Partner development store we have free access and need not subscribe. No separate account, demo or call was asked. Core action, turn on the cart drawer and look at it in the theme preview, about 2 minutes (14:14 to 14:15) and 13 steps: in the theme editor, in our own tab, the app embed EliteCart & Upsell was switched on and the theme was SAVED (Changes saved.), because that was needed to see a result. In the preview we went to The Complete Snowboard and pressed Add to cart. A cart drawer opened with The Complete Snowboard, Color: Ice, a label Buy Two, a price of $629.96 with $699.95 struck through, a row Matching Items with The Collection Snowboard: Liquid $749.95, The Multi-managed Snowboard $629.95 and The Multi-location Snowboard $729.95, and at the bottom Subtotal $1,399.90 USD, Discount -$139.98 USD, Total $1,259.92 USD and a CHECKOUT button. After Activate the Get started list showed 2 of 4 complete. IMPORTANT, this result is not proven to be EliteCart alone: our development store also had the cart apps Cross Sell Auto and Essential Cart switched on in the theme. With EliteCart off, the cart icon showed a different drawer (Cart - 1, You may also like); with EliteCart on, the cart icon still opened that other drawer, and the Matching Items drawer appeared only when Add to cart was pressed. We believe the Matching Items drawer comes from EliteCart because it appeared after the embed was switched on, but this was not confirmed separately in the Cart designer. The Buy Two discount (Discount -$139.98 USD) came from another app and cannot be credited to EliteCart. So we do not claim the drawer as a proven EliteCart result; what is proven here is the install, the plans, the approval screen and the uninstall. Plans: the Plans screen says Free access for development stores. You can access all features for free. Once you switch to a paid Shopify plan or transfer the store, you must select a plan below. A slider How many orders do you have per month? starts at 200: Essentials $29.99 /month, Includes 200 orders / month, Try for free; Professional $79.99 /month, Includes 500 orders / month, Most popular, Try for free; Enterprise Contact us, For an individual quote. With the slider at 5000 orders Essentials showed $199.99 /month and Professional $399.99 /month, both with 5000 orders a month. The ladder between 200 and 5000 orders was not opened step by step, and the dossier example of an extra $10 at 500 orders was not checked. Checkout: Try for free on Essentials opened the Shopify Approve subscription screen: You have a 15-day free trial ending on 2 Dec., Subtotal $29,99 plus any applicable taxes, Total $29,99 Due 2 Dec, $29,99 USD every 30 days, an app spending limit of a maximum of $229,99 USD per 30 days, and a note that usage charges come on top. The button Add payment method was shown and Approve was greyed out. The sentence You will not be billed for this test charge was NOT on this screen and a payment method was asked, so we did not approve, no card was entered, and we pressed Cancel. Nothing was approved. The listing says a 15-day trial and the dossier pricing page says 14 days; the Shopify screen said 15. Cancelling: no paid plan was ever started, so there was nothing to cancel. Removing the app goes through Settings, Apps, the row of the app and the menu (Open app, View details, Get support, Uninstall). The dialog says you will no longer be able to use the app, that data managed by the app, such as discounts, will be deleted, and that a request goes to the app developer within 48 hours to delete all personal customer information. A reason is required before Uninstall becomes active; we first pressed Cancel and later uninstalled the app with the reason Testing multiple apps, and Shopify confirmed that the app was uninstalled. Not tested: the Cart designer, one-click add-ons, the reward bar, the Upsells flows, Language and translations (multilingual), AI translations, EliteAI Ultra, Analytics, the paid plans and a real charge, the Plus checkout add-ons and the vendor help. Clean up: the theme was saved with the EliteCart app embed switched on (needed for the result; a second save changed nothing); the other cart apps in the store were left as they were. Our own tabs were closed. The app was uninstalled after the files were written. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: Other cart apps in the store were switched on, so the drawer in the preview could not be credited to EliteCart alone, the app embed had to be switched on and saved in the theme editor, the Essentials approval screen needs a payment method and has no test charge sentence, and usage charges come on top of the subscription.
